hooks.command: [ -f docs/TRACKER.md ] && { echo 'Sotto tracker — current state (run /next-task to start):'; sed -n '/^## Now/,/^## Phase board/p' docs/TRACKER.md | grep -v -e '^## Phase board' -e '<!--'; }; exit 0

[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] && [ -f package.json ] && command -v pnpm >/dev/null && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] && [ -f apps/agent-worker/uv.lock ] && command -v uv >/dev/null && (cd apps/agent-worker && uv sync --frozen >/dev/null 2>&1); exit 0

[ -f package.json ] || exit 0; pnpm -s exec biome check --write . >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v uv >/dev/null && (cd apps/agent-worker && uv run --frozen ruff format . ../../scripts && uv run --frozen ruff check --fix --quiet . ../../scripts) >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
[ -f package.json ] || exit 0; grep -qE '"stop_hook_active" *: *true' && exit 0; out=$({ pnpm typecheck && pnpm test; } 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -n 80 >&2; exit 2; }
